cases.event: ECB raised key rates by 50bp, moving the deposit facility rate to 0%.
cases.mechanism: asset repricing and securities reinvestment versus deposit beta, TLTRO/wholesale funding, credit demand, sovereign spreads and capital
cases.treated: Euro-area listed banks, segmented by deposit richness, fixed/floating asset mix, wholesale funding, country and IRB/output-floor sensitivity
cases.controls: European insurers, exchanges, non-euro banks; within-bank matched peers by country/size/business mix
cases.falsifier: Banks with favorable repricing exposure fail to improve normalized NII/ROTCE or price relative to matched peers once deposit and sovereign effects are controlled.

cases.event: CRR3/CRD6 package entered into application, starting phased Basel III finalization/output-floor effects.
cases.mechanism: RWA and capital requirements alter normalized return, distributable capital and required return
cases.treated: EU banks by IRB density, output-floor sensitivity, business mix and disclosed fully loaded impact
cases.controls: UK/Swiss/Japan banks; EU banks with minimal modeled-RWA sensitivity
cases.falsifier: Disclosed capital/RWA impact does not explain estimate, payout or valuation dispersion after business and macro controls.

cases.event: UBS completed its acquisition of Credit Suisse.
cases.mechanism: client/asset retention, non-core runoff, cost synergy, legal loss, capital rule and wealth-platform scale
cases.treated: UBS legal/security identity; business-level wealth, Swiss bank, asset management, investment bank and non-core observations
cases.controls: Global wealth-led banks and European investment banks; synthetic pre-deal business mix
cases.falsifier: Cost and scale benefits fail to exceed attrition, litigation, capital and integration costs on a per-share basis.

cases.event: TSE notified Prime and Standard companies of its request for cost-of-capital and stock-price-conscious management.
cases.mechanism: cross-shareholding release, buybacks/dividends, portfolio restructuring and hurdle-rate discipline change expected per-share compounding/required return
cases.treated: Japanese financials with low P/B, excess capital, policy shares and later disclosure/implementation
cases.controls: Non-disclosing/weak-response financials; non-financial low-P/B cohort; prior capital-return trends
cases.falsifier: Disclosure/action status has no incremental relation to capital release, per-share book/EPS, or relative valuation after selection controls.

cases.event: BOJ ended the negative-interest-rate/YCC framework and adopted a 0–0.1% short-rate target.
cases.mechanism: yen asset repricing, deposit pass-through, JGB/foreign-bond marks, insurer spread/economic value and market activity
cases.treated: Megabanks, regionals, life/P&C insurers, brokers and JPX segmented by asset/liability duration and policy-shareholding
cases.controls: Japanese non-financial value stocks, foreign banks/insurers, rate-insensitive financial infrastructure
cases.falsifier: Reported spread/EV/capital changes do not align with pre-event balance-sheet exposure, or price effects are fully explained by broad Japan value/yen factors.

cases.event: China reduced minimum mortgage down payments and removed national mortgage-rate floors, alongside housing support measures.
cases.mechanism: mortgage/transaction demand and property stabilization versus NIM compression, developer/LGFV risk and policy-credit economics
cases.treated: Mainland state/retail banks, insurers with property exposure, Hong Kong-listed A/H financials and HKEX/Connect context
cases.controls: Banks with low mortgage/property exposure; non-financial property cohort; prior local easing episodes
cases.falsifier: Credit formation or asset-quality expectations improve without shareholder economics, or any price response is only property beta with no bank/insurer earnings bridge.

cases.event: Hong Kong insurance reporting transitioned into the risk-based-capital regime in July 2024.
cases.mechanism: product mix, asset/liability risk, solvency surplus and disclosure change capital return and required return
cases.treated: Hong Kong-regulated life/general insurers with disclosed RBC transition effects
cases.controls: Asian insurers outside HK RBC; pre-transition historical observations retained as different regime
cases.falsifier: RBC transition has no material relationship to product, capital, remittance or valuation dispersion after market and rate controls.

cases.event: Eligible ETFs were added to Stock Connect.
cases.mechanism: eligible universe and cross-border participation can affect turnover, custody, clearing, data and sponsor economics
cases.treated: HKEX and eligible ETF/market-infrastructure businesses with direct workflow exposure
cases.controls: Non-eligible ETFs, domestic-only venues, cash-market activity excluding ETF Connect
cases.falsifier: Connect ETF activity does not become material to volume/revenue, or measured price effects precede/ignore actual adoption and monetization.

cases.event: RBI increased risk weights on consumer credit, credit-card receivables and certain bank exposures to NBFCs.
cases.mechanism: higher capital/funding cost changes growth, risk-adjusted margin, pricing, securitization and bank/NBFC linkages
cases.treated: Banks and NBFCs segmented by unsecured consumer/card exposure and dependence on bank funding
cases.controls: Secured/mortgage lenders, low-unsecured banks, nonfinancial consumer companies
cases.falsifier: Growth, pricing, capital or valuation dispersion is unrelated to pre-event exposure after credit-cycle controls.

cases.event: RBI imposed business restrictions on Paytm Payments Bank, later clarifying customer treatment.
cases.mechanism: loss of regulated rail/account capability can disrupt customer flows, partner migration, brand trust, cost and monetization
cases.treated: Paytm Payments Bank-linked issuer/ecosystem and directly dependent partners, with business/security identity separated
cases.controls: UPI/payment apps and banks without the restricted entity dependency; aggregate UPI adoption
cases.falsifier: Observed operational/customer/revenue effects are immaterial after separating ecosystem-wide UPI growth and migration to partner banks.

cases.event: APRA raised the minimum mortgage serviceability buffer from 2.5 to 3.0 percentage points.
cases.mechanism: borrowing capacity and origination mix affect mortgage growth, competition, risk, market share and future loss
cases.treated: Australian ADIs segmented by mortgage growth, high-DTI exposure, deposit franchise and broker/direct channels
cases.controls: Nonbank lenders not identically constrained; New Zealand/other banks; non-mortgage financials
cases.falsifier: Origination/mix/market-share effects do not align with pre-event exposure, or later credit outcomes show no risk differentiation.

cases.event: Korea’s Financial Services Commission introduced the Corporate Value-up Program framework.
cases.mechanism: voluntary disclosure, payout/capital plans and minority-shareholder governance can change required return and P/B discount
cases.treated: Korean financial holding companies with capital-return capacity and subsequent value-up plans
cases.controls: Non-participating financials; non-financial low-P/B cohort; prior payout trends
cases.falsifier: Plan/disclosure quality has no incremental relation to payout, per-share book/EPS or valuation after selection and market controls.
